description: Indices, gîtes, mines et carrières is a dataset listed in Données Québec open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministère des Ressources naturelles et des Forêts. Les indices, les gîtes, les mines et les carrières comprennent les informations se rapportant au pierre architecturale concassée ou industrielle, aux substances non métalliques et aux substances métalliques. Coverage: Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Ministère des Ressources naturelles et des Forêts. Its tags are gîtes, indices, pierre architecturale concassée, pierre architecturale industrielle, substances métalliques. It offers 10 resource(s) in CSV, FGDB, GPKG, HTML, SHP. The portal shows 2025-10-08 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Attribution (CC-BY 4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-quebec-portal.
